annotations.title: Contact Quiet Hours Check (Recipient's Local Time)

description: Check whether a planned send time falls inside the recipient's local quiet hours before an agent texts, calls or emails. Send the send date and time (and the IANA time zone that clock reads in, UTC if you leave it out), the recipient's IANA time zone (for example America/Chicago) and the quiet hours your policy sets (default 21:00 to 08:00, the 8 a.m. to 9 p.m. calling window of the US telemarketing rule). Get back the recipient's local date, time, weekday and UTC offset, whether the time is inside the quiet hours, and, if it is, the next time sending is allowed (in the recipient's zone, in UTC and in your zone) and the minutes to wait; if it is not, the minutes until quiet hours start. Handles windows that cross midnight and the days clocks change. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/quiet-hours-check). Labels are your own text: emails, web addresses and long digit runs are refused. Not legal, tax or financial advice.

label.description: Optional label, for example 'reminder batch 3' (your own text, echoed; not a person).

quiet_end.description: Local time quiet hours end (sending is allowed from this time), HH:MM. Default 08:00. A start later than the end means hours that cross midnight.

quiet_start.description: Local time quiet hours start (included in quiet hours), HH:MM. Default 21:00.

recipient_zone.description: IANA time zone of the recipient's location, for example America/Chicago, Asia/Kolkata.

repeated_time.description: When send_zone's clock shows the send time twice (clocks going back): first (default) or second occurrence.

send_date.description: Planned send date as read in send_zone, YYYY-MM-DD.

send_time.description: Planned send time as read on the clock in send_zone, 24-hour HH:MM.

send_zone.description: IANA time zone the send date and time are read in, for example America/New_York. Default UTC.

name: quiet_hours_check
